# Inspector E2E test triggers

These phrases drive diagnostic and integration flows in Playwright and manual inspector sessions. They are listed in the welcome and help responses (`example_questions` slot in `domain/general/welcome.yml`) and summarized below by category.

MCP-backed flows use the local mock server on `http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp` (plain-text `result.content`).

## Inspector diagnostics

| Utterance | Flow | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inspector test direct mcp success` | `inspector_direct_mcp_success` | Context7 `resolve-library-id` via mock MCP |
| `inspector test custom tool success` | `inspector_custom_tool_success` | `inspector_toolbox` → `inspector_success_marker` |
| `inspector test custom tool failure` | `inspector_custom_tool_error` | `inspector_toolbox` → `inspector_failure_marker` (tool error) |
| `inspector test agent success` | `inspector_agent_success` | `library_docs` sub-agent |
| `inspector test memory and buttons` | `inspector_memory_and_buttons` | Slots, buttons, custom payload |
| `inspector test direct mcp failure` | `inspector_direct_mcp_failure` | Unreachable `inspector_unreachable_mcp` |
| `inspector test action failure` | `inspector_custom_action_failure` | `action_inspector_raise_failure` |

**Deferred (follow-up PR):** `inspector test agent timeout`, rich-content flows, flow-cancel flows.

## Context7 integration

| Utterance pattern | Flow |
| --- | --- |
| Ask for the Context7 / canonical id of a library (e.g. “What is the Context7 id for next.js?”) | `lookup_library_id` |
| Ask how something works in a named library (e.g. “How do I use middleware in Next.js?”) | `ask_library_docs` |

## DeepWiki / GitHub

| Utterance pattern | Flow / sub-agent |
| --- | --- |
| Generic public repo question (e.g. “How does routing work in rasaHQ/rasa?”) | `public_github_repo_info` → `deepwiki_github` |
| Repo question that **mentions MCP** (e.g. “Using MCP, what is rasaHQ/rasa?”) | `public_github_repo_info_mcp` → `ask_question` tool |

## Finance demo (Playwright default)

| Utterance | Flow |
| --- | --- |
| `say hello` / welcome triggers | `welcome` |
| `help` | `help` |
| Banking intents (balance, transfer, cards, …) | Finance flows in `data/` |
